args.body: For CATALOGUE-LIVE-PILOT-INQUIRY-ACCEPTANCE, reuse products/distribution/catalogue-referral/live-pilot-link-check.json if its execution receipt confirms commitment. The check ties the decoded link fields to the November 18 fetch and computes the exact item 4 draft hash. Use the existing mission to compare the draft wording and requested inputs with the verified release and private intake contract. If they align, finish the copy-ready handoff for the existing operator send-or-decline decision. If they differ, identify the smallest concrete correction. Read back the saved handoff before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep external sending and any independently reviewed public revision separate. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement.

description: The November 18 fetch verified that the catalogue QA page is live. The next step is to check whether the existing pilot draft points buyers to an inquiry path that preserves the experiment identifier and matches the page’s intake limits. This can support one operator-authorized pilot using the existing offer. The feedback system has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both CAD 0. A matching link would establish the public inquiry path only. Operator authorization, actual attribution, order acceptance and settlement each require separate evidence.
